_comment: Radial Biomes main config. Edit this file, then restart the server. Changes to tier files are reloaded on server start too.

continentalness._comment: Controls the islands-to-continental gradient. centerBias is applied at world origin, outerBias at falloffDistance. Range is clamped to [-1, 1] internally.
continentalness._help_centerBias: Negative = more ocean/islands at spawn. -0.8 forces a strong archipelago. -0.4 gives mixed islands-and-small-continents. 0.0 disables island bias.
continentalness._help_outerBias: Usually 0 so the outer world looks like whatever Terralith/Tectonic want. Set positive to force more solid continent.
continentalness._help_falloffDistance: Distance at which outerBias is reached, in blocks.

latitudeTemperature._comment: Real-world-like temperature by latitude. Only applied when Natural Temperature mod is NOT installed. If NT is installed, this block is ignored.
latitudeTemperature._help_forceEnabled: true = apply our own latitude temperature (equator warm, poles cold). false = leave temperature to the delegate biome source.
latitudeTemperature._help_polarDistance: Distance along Z axis at which temperature reaches full cold offset (~-0.8). 15000 gives a slowly-cooling world; 5000 gives a tight climate band.
